judgement.text: Games Workshop is the source of truth. Where New Recruit, BSData or Wahapedia say something else, the difference is written down with its reason, and every release checks it again.

What AI wrote is marked on the tables above: summaries and readings. Each carries a fingerprint of the rule text it was written from, so a change in GW’s words flags it, and every judgement the app adds is signed off by an independent reviewer; a changed rule voids its sign-off.
Nothing ships unless every check passes: the build refuses to run otherwise.
